JORDAN : MLUGXQ :: FRAGILE : ?
questions.solution:
According to the English alphabet series and its positional value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1196a07d03c9f02e7bec22cfc36a195fd3a58e076da25a1e2a394b79aea80ec7.png] 

The logic follows here is:

***Consonant is increased by 3 and vowels are decreased by 3.***

 
• ***Consonants + 3***
 
• ***Vowels - 3***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f00ed38fd7170571adea15b1145915adfea8bc239a8720e65d00bc68426732d.png] 

Similarly;

 
• *Consonants + 3*

Hence, **"IUXJFOB"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

ADIJ : ES :: BDGH : ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54c9d52205610f923e1e91b9920dcb4c09ca0ead56ef220130741de93e664bcf.png] 

**Logic :**

 
• **Sum of the position value of first two letters of first part = Position value of the first letter of the second part**
 
• **Sum of the position value of last two letters of first part = Position value of the second letter of the second part**

So,

 
• ADIJ : ES

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/605228cb0a4e0aad9ac24e422b74408b8731c08d6d20d7cd936471315b4825fb.png] ​

• BDGH : ?

Hence, **"FO"** is the correct answer.
